```{r}
names(protein_raw)[duplicated(names(protein_raw))] ##zoek voor dubbele proteinen
protein_raw_numeric <- protein_raw[, -1]
  
outliers <- lapply(protein_raw, function(x) {
  Q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  IQR <- Q3 - Q1

  which(x < (Q1 - 1.5 * IQR) |
        x > (Q3 + 1.5 * IQR))
})
npx_only <- protein_raw_numeric[,-1]

protein_stats <- data.frame(
  protein = colnames(npx_only),
  min = apply(npx_only, 2, min, na.rm = TRUE),
  max = apply(npx_only, 2, max, na.rm = TRUE),
  mean = apply(npx_only, 2, mean, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd = apply(npx_only, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
)

head(protein_stats)

#all_values <- unlist(protein_raw_numeric[,-1])
#boxplot(all_values,
#        horizontal =TRUE,
 #       main = "Distribution of NPX values")

set.seed(123)

selected <- sample(colnames(protein_raw)[-1], 20)

plot_data <- protein_raw %>%
  select(all_of(selected)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "Protein",
    values_to = "NPX"
  )

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = NPX)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    fill = "steelblue",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Protein, ncol = 5) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of 20 randomly selected proteins",
    x = "NPX value",
    y = "Count"
  )
```
